subject.title: Feature: Inject context window % into system prompt runtime section

question: Should OpenClaw expose volatile per-turn context usage inside the agent system-prompt Runtime line, despite prompt cache and freshness tradeoffs?
rationale: The code already has token usage data and status rendering, but adding a changing value to the system prompt is a core prompt-runtime product decision rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Approve narrow Runtime field
options.body: Thread a bounded fresh context percentage or short token pair into runtimeInfo and buildRuntimeLine with tests for stale-token omission and prompt rendering.

options.title: Keep tool/status only
options.body: Decline prompt injection and keep session_status, /status, and runtime self-context discussion as the supported context-usage surfaces.

options.title: Wait for runtime self-context
options.body: Defer this narrow field until the broader runtime self-context design in the linked issue and PR is accepted or closed.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow Runtime field
recommendation.body: Thread a bounded fresh context percentage or short token pair into runtimeInfo and buildRuntimeLine with tests for stale-token omission and prompt rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest source-history signal for the prompt Runtime line and runtimeInfo plumbing points to Peter-authored commits.
